subject.title: fix(voice-call): persist assistant transcript on call.speaking events

question: Should this branch be narrowed to the voice-call transcript fix and split or redesign the boot-session memory changes before any merge?
rationale: The central voice-call bug is real, but the branch also changes session-state and BOOT.md security behavior in ways that need maintainer ownership and cannot be settled by green unit tests or automated repair.

options.title: Rebase And Narrow Voice Fix
options.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, keep the voice transcript persistence focused, preserve timer and BOOT.md safeguards, prevent duplicate bot turns, and require redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Split Boot-Session Memory Work
options.body: Move the boot-run key, memory ingestion, host SDK export, and reaper changes to a separate PR with explicit session-state and security proof.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Exists
options.body: Keep this PR blocked if the contributor cannot provide inspectable redacted live transcript evidence for the changed call path.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Narrow Voice Fix
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts against current main, keep the voice transcript persistence focused, preserve timer and BOOT.md safeguards, prevent duplicate bot turns, and require redacted live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and current-main history owner for the central voice-call and BOOT.md conflict surfaces.
